extracted.intended_audience: authors and writers seeking literary representation / people preparing queries/submissions to agents
extracted.subtask_description: A feed of literary-agent 'wish list' posts specifying what kinds of manuscripts or proposals the agent wants (genres, age categories, themes, and submission method requirements). Useful for authors tailoring queries or submissions to specific agents' preferences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventive middle grade fantasy
rubrics_metrics.description: "Send me inventive middle grade fantasy novels."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples given to indicate tone/style and market comparables: THE GIRL WHO DRANK THE MOON; WHEN YOU TRAP A TIGER; THE LAND OF STORIES; THE SCHOOL FOR GOOD AND EVIL. Implies target age category = middle grade (MG), emphasis on originality/inventiveness within fantasy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Nonfiction proposals with a new perspective on entertaining topics
rubrics_metrics.description: "I want nonfiction proposals that offer a new perspective on an entertaining topic in any of these categories: art, the environment, pop culture, science, psychology, cultural history, and the occult."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposal must present a fresh angle ('new perspective') and be engaging/entertaining. Acceptable subject categories explicitly listed: art; the environment; pop culture; science; psychology; cultural history; the occult. This is both topical and tonal guidance for nonfiction submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Query method requirement: QueryTracker only
rubrics_metrics.description: "I only accept queries via Querytracker: querytracker.net/query/MacLysaght"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedural submission requirement: do not query via other channels; use the specified QueryTracker link. Note in post: the link will open May 15th, 2026 — timing/availability matters. This is an explicit agent-level gatekeeping rule (how to submit).
